content_of_post_to_comment: My students were shocked to learn that I have vague childhood memories of watching the Berlin Wall coming down on the news. I am ancient. Moss grows between my fingers and my heart beats at the tempo of an acorn sending forth roots.
comment: The funny thing about memories of world events is how they blur personal and historical time. A child can witness a turning point without grasping it, then spend decades discovering what that moment meant.
